question: What is the Resulticks acquisition supposed to unlock — revenue synergies or cost savings?

beat.line: Resulticks is a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.
beat.headline: REVENUE SYNERGY
beat.action: A halftone paper document drops onto a cream chip and settles flat.

sources: based on the showcase material provided earlier, the Resulticks acquisition is positioned as a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: soft violet. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: soft violet.
Subjects: a paper document; a cream paper chip.
Opens cold on the ground colour; the first subject enters on the first frame.
Action: A halftone paper document drops onto a cream chip and settles flat.
Ends holding on the document.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "REVENUE SYNERGY".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "REVENUE SYNERGY". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Resulticks is a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.
expandedPrompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Modern editorial paper collage animation, overhead flat-lay composition, Static Shot photographed flat under soft, diffuse upper-left room light. The entire background is a single, flat, unbroken sheet of matte soft violet paper with subtle tactile fiber texture. On the very first frame, a crisp rectangular cream paper chip swiftly enters from above and lands with a slight physical overshoot into the upper third of the frame, settling flat to cast a faint, soft directional shadow toward the bottom-right. Printed across the center of this chip is clean, stark, extra-bold black sans-serif text reading "REVENUE SYNERGY". Concurrently in the lower two-thirds, a larger geometric cream paper shape snaps into place. Immediately following, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a plain, completely blank and unprinted paper document with fibrous, rough white torn-paper edges drops rapidly onto the cream shape, flexing slightly upon impact before slapping down completely flat. An adult narrator (S1) with a warm, articulate, and brisk English voice says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] Resulticks is a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.</d> The layered paper elements maintain a locked, balanced magazine layout through the remainder of the shot, holding a clear reading window under the steady, matte lighting with microscopic, natural tactile paper settling.

overall_soundscape: A sharp, crisp whoosh accompanies the initial entrance of the paper, followed by a tight, dry paper-slap sound as the cream headline chip lands, layered with a distinct, tactile paper-on-paper flutter and soft impact thud as the halftone document drops and settles flat against a quiet, neutral room tone.
